resources.string: Credits & references
The upstream project this fork is based on.
Reference repository: many practical features come from this branch.

Reference fork and the source of the Xiaomi Super Island support: the official miui.focus param_v2 protocol, the dual-channel island-expansion mechanism (first-post-only expansion, 8-second auto-dismiss), and its on-device measurement notes.
Reference fork and the source of the Dynamic-Island thought stream: streaming thinking/output previews, semantic tool labels, and the notification chronometer.
Reference fork and the source of the Xiaomi host bridges: the HyperOS 4 UIAgent tool bridge, the internal ToolsBridge, and the vision / external-agent services.
Core reference for the agent runtime, including the agent loop, tool calling, steering, and transcript state management.

DeepSeek\'s open-source proactive agent prototype. The source of the session-dispatch concept: a main session that only routes and assesses, the ticket/mandate/admission pipeline, and behavioral laws of structured questions and honest reporting.

An AI agent desktop workspace. The reference for the dispatch console\'s session form and mechanics: the tool-allowlisted dispatch mode, self-contained briefs, notify-once completion claims, and the anti-injection discipline.
Reference project for Android AI agents.
Terminal AI coding agent. The protocol reference for the remote OpenCode integration; the v2 wire protocol was verified against its serve implementation (v2.2.5).
k2-fsa offline speech runtime (sherpa-onnx and sherpa-ncnn). The Kotlin JNI bindings are bundled (Apache-2.0), powering local speech recognition, synthesis, and VAD.
Adapted source of the built-in browser. The browser code is adapted from this project (GPL-3.0) with package/resource isolation, Linux guest path mapping, cookie offload, and user takeover.
Image-generation protocol reference. Reference-image/mask editing, size tiers, and the JSON edit protocol were verified against its ApiModels and ImageRepository implementations.
A SillyTavern plugin and the design inspiration for the NovelAI workbench; no source was copied, only its public interface behavior was used as the compatibility target.
Modern Xposed API.

Navigation-only page-transition library: the NavDisplay container provides stack transitions and system display-corner adaptation; the UI components themselves are Material Design 3 Expressive, not miuix widgets.
Markdown rendering library for chat messages and overlay content, with Compose multiplatform rendering and Material 3 styling.
Style reference for the user chat bubbles. Its bubble design closely resembles the sample bubbles in Google Material Design 3 Expressive, so it was adopted and adapted for this project.
The official Google Material Design 3 Expressive site. This app\'s design language and visual style reference its examples and specifications.
Design reference for the app\'s Appearance & theme settings sub-pages.

Thanks to all open-source models that run locally on phones — speech synthesis and recognition models, embedding models, and others — which let EtaExpressive handle voice interaction, semantic retrieval, and local inference without relying on the cloud.
